_comment: What the player may do to the world (`PlayerState`, `PlayerCommands`). Each power has `charges` (-1 for no limit) and `cooldown_seconds` of simulated time between uses; a scenario overrides them. The powers' own settings sit beside them: a herd is led no further than `max_distance` in a straight line and `max_route` along the way it would walk (the route search's cost); a cull takes up to `max_kills` of `species` within `radius_of_mean` of the map's mean pond. `offered` lists the powers a world has; a scenario names its own. The reserve's (`adopt`, `rain`, `drought`, `cold_snap`, `bloom`, `good_litter`) are offered only where the reserve mode lists them (`reserve.json`): a viewer naming a ward, the weather, a year of bigger litters for one species (`extra` young more in each, paced by the reserve's funds rather than a cooldown). The world is an island: no power brings animals from outside it.
